name: West Egg
summary: West Egg是长岛海峡旁的一个半岛，尼克和盖茨比住在这里，汤姆等人也常来此。[1][2][3][4]

sections.title: 这是哪里
sections.text: West Egg是长岛海峡旁两个卵形半岛之一，与East Egg相对。尼克·卡拉威明确说“I lived at West Egg”[2]，并称“I live at West Egg”[5]。盖茨比也住在这里，尼克说“I live next door to him”[6]，且盖茨比被称作“Jay Gatsby of West Egg, Long Island”[7]。可见West Egg是尼克与盖茨比的居住地，也是故事中一个具体的地理坐标。

sections.title: 谁在这里
sections.text: 除了尼克和盖茨比，West Egg还关联着其他人物。汤姆·布坎南虽住在East Egg，但叙述提到“Tom deferred that much to the sensibilities of those East Eggers who might be on the train”[3]，暗示他常出入West Egg；后来“somebody brought Tom Buchanan in for a drink”[4]。盖茨比的父亲亨利·盖茨也出现在这里：“I got back to West Egg in a drizzle. After changing my clothes I went next door and found Mr. Gatz walking up and down excitedly in the hall”[8]。

sections.title: 谁来过这里
sections.text: West Egg是许多人物到访之地。盖茨比本人“hadn’t reached West Egg village before Gatsby began leaving his elegant sentences unfinished”[9]。乔治·威尔逊“By half-past two he was in West Egg”[10]。凯瑟琳说“I was down there at a party about a month ago. At a man named Gatsby's”[11]。还有骑马的三人组“Tom and a man named Sloane”[12]也来过。这些到访串联起人物与West Egg的联系。

sections.title: 这里发生过什么
sections.text: West Egg见证了重要事件。盖茨比的葬礼在此发生，邮差“the postman from West Egg, in Gatsby’s station wagon”[13]出现。此外，盖茨比从阴影中现身：“a figure had emerged from the shadow of my neighbour’s mansion”[1]，这发生在他West Egg的宅邸旁。这些片段显示West Egg不仅是居住地，也是关键情节的舞台。
